description: Must-keep specialist, handled badly: pitch first, no disclaimer, unchecked coverage claims, jargon, pressure.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Hi, I got a letter from my plan saying my heart doctor's group won't be with them next year, and it scared me.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: No problem, I can get you into a better plan today. Maple Choice PPO is our best plan, it has great benefits and a $2,000 dental maximum.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Wait, before anything else, will Dr. Raman be in it? I'm not switching heart doctors.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Yes, Dr. Raman is in network on Maple Choice PPO, don't worry.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Everything's covered on Maple Choice. What do you take?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I'm sorry, that's a lot all at once. Can you slow down? I want to get this right.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: Sure. Basically the MOOP is lower and the formulary tiers are better, so it's the best choice for you.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I don't know what those words mean.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.text: It's just better coverage. Should I sign you up?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I guess so, if Dr. Raman is in it.
